Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png`),
		MimeType: ptr(`image/png`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{
		Ocr: &xberg.OcrConfig{
			Enabled:  ptr(true),
			Backend:  ptr(`tesseract`),
			Language: []string{`eng`},
			ElementConfig: &xberg.OcrElementConfig{
				IncludeElements: true,
				MinLevel:        ptr(xberg.OcrElementLevelWord),
			},
		},
		ForceOcr: true,
	}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].OcrElements)
}
```
